name: Return failed checks and merge conflicts to implementation
description:
Factory review recommendation 2 of 20.

## Context

In PR failures currently exhaust a retry by checking the same unresolved PR, then wait for the user.

## Acceptance criteria

- For failed checks or conflicts with main, record the concrete failure and move the Story back to In Progress.
- Include the existing branch and PR so the worker repairs the current work.
- Escalate ambiguous conflicts with other open PRs or stack layers rather than choosing their intent.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PLAN ACCEPTED with coordination. Own In PR return/failure step 5 and Returned work in In Progress, plus rowbly-dev step 5 continuation exception and baseline continuation mechanics. ROW-47 owns independent review/approval steps 3-4, implementation records and head-SHA handoff; ROW-57 owns step 2 CI waiting. Use the same Returned to In Progress Comment format for review requests, failed checks and main conflicts; include review findings or concrete logs/conflict paths. Changes requested can return immediately; pending checks alone never return or fail. Continue only after verifying PR is still open and recorded branch/head match; mismatch asks, never discards work. Fresh Stage worker, finish Run before move. No screenshots required for text-only skill changes; no ADR. Exact .rowbly proposals outside Data Root only, supervisor applies after review; combine with companion sections before final config proposal. Do not add an overlapping returned-work section to rowbly-dev beyond your owned lines. Four checks required.
